annotation_notes: HELD-OUT TEST SET. The extraction heuristics were tuned against
F1 1.000 — a result that cannot be trusted as evidence of generalisation
because the same person wrote both the heuristics and those annotations.
This procedure was annotated WITHOUT running the extractor against it, and
is structurally different (cursor batch loop, tiered rates, per-row error
Same criteria applied for consistency: a rule CONSTRAINS or DEFINES what
the business permits. Mechanics are excluded — as 'debit source, credit
destination' was excluded in SP_TRANSFER_FUNDS, so are the UPDATE/INSERT
statements and the simple new_balance addition here.

rules.statement: Only accounts with status ACTIVE and an account type beginning SAVINGS are eligible for monthly interest.
rules.subject: account_status

rules.statement: The number of days in the interest month is taken from the run date's calendar month.
rules.subject: v_days_in_month

rules.statement: A balance below 100,000 earns an annual interest rate of 3.0%.
rules.subject: rec.balance

rules.statement: A balance below 1,000,000 earns an annual interest rate of 3.5%.
rules.subject: rec.balance

rules.statement: A balance below 10,000,000 earns an annual interest rate of 4.0%.
rules.subject: rec.balance

rules.statement: A balance of 10,000,000 or more earns an annual interest rate of 4.5%.
rules.subject: v_interest_rate

rules.statement: Monthly interest is the balance multiplied by the annual rate, prorated by days in month over 365, rounded to two decimals.
rules.subject: v_interest_amount

rules.statement: Interest is credited only when the computed interest amount is greater than zero.
rules.subject: v_interest_amount

rules.statement: A failure processing one account is logged to the batch error log and does not stop the batch.
rules.subject: p_accounts_failed

rules.statement: A failure at batch level rolls back the whole run and reports application error -20010.
rules.subject: batch
